description: Trial results the VASI-shaped extraction does not reach, each with the randomised group size so the figure can be bracketed. Two kinds so far: a published primary outcome whose full text is not fetchable (HI-Light, on the Vitiligo Noticeability Scale), and a posted secondary outcome on an instrument the arm table does not parse (NCT03099304, patient global impression of change). These rows are deliberately kept out of curation/topline-results.json, which is frozen by hash because v0.4, v0.5 and the evidence ranking are defined by it. Nothing here feeds a model: no row is a VASI threshold, so the model's instrument filter excludes them all. Each row stores the responder count as well as the percentage: a rate kept to one decimal does not always recover its numerator by multiplication, so the count is recorded rather than re-derived.

results.source: HI-Light Vitiligo Trial, Br J Dermatol 2021 (PMID 33006767); HTA 24(64) (PMID 33245043)
results.note: Counts as printed in the abstract, not derived from a percentage. The full text could not be fetched: the NIHR library, the institutional repository and Europe PMC's book page all answer a bot check, so no table cell was verified. Randomised group size 173; 54 of that arm were missing at the primary endpoint, so the assumption-free bound is 11.6% to 42.8%. The trial's own primary analysis used multiple imputation and reported an adjusted difference for combination versus TCS of 10.9% (95% CI 1.0-20.9, p=0.032, NNT 10).
